display_information.name: three.ws
display_information.description: Talk to your three.ws AI agent in Slack: balances, positions, trade approvals with buttons, and account alerts.
display_information.long_description:
three.ws gives every person an AI agent with its own 3D body and wallet. This app brings that agent into Slack, so you can work with it where your team already talks.

*What you can do*
• Ask your agent anything in a direct message, or mention @three.ws in a channel. Replies land in a thread, so channels stay readable.
• Run `/three balance`, `/three portfolio`, `/three positions` or `/three runs` from anywhere. The answer is private to you.
• Review trades before they happen. When your agent prepares one, you get a preview with Approve and Cancel buttons. Nothing runs from text alone, and a preview expires after ten minutes.
• Approve or deny the requests your spend policy holds, and stop agents at once with `/three pause` or `/three kill`.
• Send a voice clip or an image and the agent hears or reads it.

*Getting started*
Open the app's Home tab after installing. Send the app any message to get a pairing code, then confirm it on three.ws (Settings, Connections). Already signed in on three.ws? Generate a code there and run `/three link <code>` instead.

*Privacy*
The app reads only direct messages sent to it and messages that mention it. Each workspace's bot token is stored encrypted, and uninstalling the app erases it immediately. Details: https://three.ws/legal/privacy#slack
